free_tier_limits: Default Public API access: 5,000 requests per day and 2 requests per second.
rate_limits: 5,000 requests per day and 2 requests per second by default. The Discovery API reference inconsistently states 5 requests per second; the lower Discovery-specific FAQ limit is used conservatively.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: 5,000/day and 2/second per the current Discovery FAQ: https://developer.ticketmaster.com/support/faq/ . rate_limits: same; the v2 reference conflicts at 5/second, so the lower FAQ figure controls: https://developer.ticketmaster.com/products-and-docs/apis/discovery-api/v2/ . cors: yes; official getting-started documentation explicitly supports CORS, and v2 responses show Access-Control-Allow-Origin:*: https://developer.ticketmaster.com/products-and-docs/apis/getting-started/
